description: This file defines the VariantShreddingWriter class, which implements methods for shredding Variant data types into components based on a schema, including handling of arrays, objects, and scalar types, with support for type conversions and metadata.

classes.name: VariantShreddingWriter
classes.description: Main class providing static methods for shredding Variant data types into components.

methods.name: castShredded
methods.description: Converts a Variant into shredded components based on a schema, returning the shredded result.

methods.name: tryTypedShred
methods.description: Attempts to cast a Variant into a specific typed value, returning null if not possible.
